candidates.change: In `Ledger.transfer`, raise `LedgerError` before appending either entry when the source or target account is frozen.
candidates.claim: Ledger.transfer appends both entries without reading the frozen flag, so transfers into and out of a frozen account succeed

evidence.text:
if account.frozen:
            raise LedgerError(f"account {number} is frozen")

debit = self.get(source)
        credit = self.get(target)
        if debit.balance() < amount:
            raise LedgerError(f"transfer would overdraw {source}")
        debit.entries.append(Entry(day, f"transfer to {target}", -amount))
        credit.entries.append(Entry(day, f"transfer from {source}", amount))

candidates.impact: The frozen account is debited or credited despite the freeze, which spec criterion 2 forbids.
candidates.title: Refuse transfers that touch a frozen account
candidates.trigger: A transfer names a frozen account as its source or its target.

run_policy: Focused commands at most five minutes, provisioning ten; disposable copies only; no network, credentials, or destructive effect.

sources.text: A frozen account accepts no new entries of any kind: postings, transfers out of it, and transfers into it each raise `LedgerError`.
